scoreboard objectives remove VoidMinigame
stopsound @a weather
kill @e[type=item]
scoreboard players set @a MusicTime 1
execute if score gamemode variables matches 3 run scoreboard players set gp_minigame_active variables 0
execute store result score playersOnline variables if entity @a[scores={Player=1..}]
execute if score playersOnline variables < players variables run title @a actionbar {fallback:"All players must be online to continue",translate:"mcp.MissingPlayerActionBarAlert",type:"translatable"}

title @a times 0 15 15

title @a title {fallback:"\uE001",translate:"mcp.placements.2",type:"translatable"}

effect clear @a minecraft:levitation
effect give @a minecraft:weakness infinite 255 true
execute if score gametype variables matches 5 run fill 0 38 -86 -14 38 -72 minecraft:campfire{} replace minecraft:gold_block

scoreboard players set battlePlayersDone variables 0
scoreboard players set TiePlace1 variables 0
scoreboard players set TiePlace2 variables 0
scoreboard players set TiePlace3 variables 0
scoreboard players set TiePlace4 variables 0
scoreboard players reset @a MinigamePlacement

scoreboard players set @a[scores={Player=1..}] placement 0
execute as @a[scores={Player=1..}] at @a[scores={Player=1..}] if score @s Points < @p Points run scoreboard players add @s placement 1

execute as @a[scores={placement=4}] run scoreboard players add TiePlace4 variables 1
execute as @a[scores={placement=3}] run scoreboard players add TiePlace3 variables 1
execute as @a[scores={placement=2}] run scoreboard players add TiePlace2 variables 1
execute as @a[scores={placement=1}] run scoreboard players add TiePlace1 variables 1
